segments.ja394:1.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, kiso tvamasi vāyasa.
segments.ja394:3.1: Niccaṃ ubbegino [ubbiggino (syā. ka.), ubbedhino (sī.)] kākā, dhaṅkā pāpena kammunā;
segments.ja394:3.3: Laddho piṇḍo na pīṇeti, kiso tenasmi vaṭṭaka.
segments.ja394:4.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, thūlo tvamasi vaṭṭaka.
segments.ja394:6.1: Appicchassa hi posassa, appacintasukhassa [appacintisukhassa (sī. syā. pī.)] ca;
